thread_text:
Mina Shah: Hey team 44b Mina here, excited to join Eng-Platform today. Laptop arrived but Jamf link didn't show up and VPN fails with auth. Who do I ping for Git org access and SSH key setup? Icebreaker: two truths and a lie  1) I once biked across New Zealand, 2) I brew my own ginger beer, 3) I have a pet parrot named Nimbus. Which is the lie?

Carlos - eng-platform: Welcome Mina!! I'm your manager. I'll loop in IT and assign a buddy. @Sam will help with repos and SSH. Also, team lunch Thursday?

Nellie (IT): Hi Mina, Nellie from IT. Please DM the device serial and OS. If Jamf email missing I'll resend and approve your device manually. For VPN, try reinstalling the client after enrolling.

Mina Shah: MacBook Pro, serial C02MKL98765. Jamf invite not in spam.

Nellie (IT): Got it 44b Resending Jamf invite and approving now. Expect the enrollment prompt in ~5 mins.

Sam (buddy): Hey Mina, I'm your onboarding buddy. For SSH, run: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "mina.shah@redwood.com"` and paste the public key in the access form. DM me if you want me to add you directly.

Jo - HR: Quick reminder 514 - please complete benefits enrollment and payroll forms within 72 hours: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding. Also we mail a welcome sticker pack 60a DM address to Nellie.

Mina Shah: Update: Jamf invite arrived and device enrolled. Submitted SSH pub key to the form. VPN connected after enrollment. Also, the parrot is the lie 992 I do brew ginger beer and did the NZ bike trip. Thanks everyone for the quick help!

Carlos - eng-platform: Awesome, welcome officially! We'll do a repo walkthrough tomorrow and pair for the first ticket. See you at lunch Thursday :rocket:
